text: Before any performance measurement: refine completion endpoint from root snapshot to a real post-layout QuantumRenderer queue fence. The FX action and ready-view checks remain timed; a post-layout pulse completes before a RenderJob fence is enqueued on the FX thread, and its completion ends the timing. Snapshot exports are separate evidence outside timing, since they add work absent from normal interaction. No observations have yet been collected and no thresholds change. Strengthen readiness to exact linked timeline/source row and populated native plots.
